OnyxPDF Background Remover — third-party attributions
======================================================

MODEL — IS-Net ("general-use")
  Project:  DIS (Dichotomous Image Segmentation), by Xuebin Qin et al.
  Source:   https://github.com/xuebinqin/DIS
  Licence:  Apache License 2.0 — full text in LICENSE-DIS.txt (the DIS
            repository's own LICENSE.md). Note: the DIS README (section 7,
            Term of Use) names "code and evaluation metric" for Apache
            License 2.0; the trained weights are distributed by the same
            project inside that same repository under its single license,
            with no separate or non-commercial terms for the weights.
  What we ship: the project's official `isnet-general-use` weights,
            converted to ONNX by the rembg project (MIT; the fp32 ONNX
            asset md5 fc16ebd8b0c10d971d3513d564d01e29 matches rembg's
            published checksum) and further converted fp32 -> fp16 by
            Onyx AI Labs with onnxconverter-common. The model file here is
            split into <=4 MiB chunks listed in resources.json and is
            reassembled in the browser.

RUNTIME — ONNX Runtime Web 1.20.1
  Project:  ONNX Runtime, by Microsoft Corporation
  Source:   https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime
  Licence:  MIT License — full text in LICENSE-onnxruntime.txt.
  What we ship: the unmodified npm dist files ort.wasm.min.mjs,
            ort-wasm-simd-threaded.mjs and ort-wasm-simd-threaded.wasm
            (chunked the same way as the model).

GLUE CODE — the loader, preprocessing and compositing in
js/tools-bgremove.js is Onyx AI Labs' own work, written for OnyxPDF. It
replicates the input/output handling published in the DIS project's
Inference.py and in rembg's ISNet session (MIT).
